page.layout: One scan showing the inside of a book cover: a parchment wrapper with a blank pasted-down leaf, no printed text. Bottom left: pencil handwriting (not print). Faint marks in the upper right of the leaf are not legible.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The pencil inscription at the foot reads roughly "auct. comp. 1857" with a second line of numerals ("120103" or similar), which is handwriting and is therefore left out. Faint ink marks near the upper right of the leaf are not legible and are treated as show-through or stains. The page shows the binding's thongs and a torn leather tie at the right edge, which are not text.
